summary.result: Land-use changes from one category to others have been clearly represented by the NDVI composite images, which were found suitable for delineating the development of urban areas and land use changes in northern Cheongju region.
summary.background: Land-use in northern Cheongju region is changing rapidly because of the increased interactions of human activities with the environment as population increases.
summary.method: Land-use statistics revealed that substantial land-use changes have taken place and that the built-up areas have expanded by about $17.57km^2$ (11.47%) over the study period (1991 - 2000).
